verdict.rationale: Statsig is a SaaS platform that ingests customer event and user data, so a buyer can fairly ask whether that data may be used for AI model training. The evidence pack contains no documented opt-out, policy, or contractual commitment against AI training. Warehouse Native, which runs analysis in the customer's own warehouse, is a different capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
